tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every page. Warm off-white, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Tables, forms, document previews and panels that sit on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Source-snippet wells, table header rows, read-only inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and panel edges. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes (3.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on canvas, surface and accent (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and helper copy on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (5.0:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Brief's original secondary grey. 4:1 on canvas: placeholders and 24px+ text only, never body copy.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and mobile top bar ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered and active nav rows inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Nav labels and headings on sidebar (14.7:1).

tokens.name: sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Nav section labels and counts on sidebar (5.7:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime. Primary action fill, active-nav marker, recommended rule. A FILL, never text on light grounds (1.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (13.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table rows and the chosen lineup column background.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text that must read as 'accent' on light grounds, e.g. 'Recommended' label (7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed-by-team, Approved, Paid. Text and icons on surface and success-soft (5.6:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success chips and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Uncertain fields, over-budget notes, quote nearing expiry. Text on warning-soft (5.1:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning chips and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missing required fields, errors, destructive actions. Text on danger-soft (5.6:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of missing/error chips and banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px canvas gap. Lime is too light to be a ring.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact rows and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, field label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on mobile, gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop, gap between field groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, checkboxes, rule-trace tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and document previews. The largest radius in the product.

tokens.name: shadow-doc
tokens.usage: A4 document previews only: the one thing that sits 'on' the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense table actions on desktop.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height on desktop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: All controls on mobile; primary page actions.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Lucide icons in chips, tables and buttons (stroke 1.75).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Lucide icons in nav and page headers (stroke 1.75).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: large phones.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablets; sidebar collapses below this.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: laptop; lineup columns go side by side.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktop; quote and document preview side by side.
